Two things cap it at 6 rather than higher: leg 1 is a C$4.35B cash OUTFLOW that raises leverage from an already-heavy 4.3x net-debt/EBITDA and only sets a comp — the actual monetization is leg 2, which has no named counterparty, no signed agreement and a timeline already drifting toward H1-2027; and this is a $20B, fully-covered name whose SoP gap is a long-standing Rogers-family control discount that prior crystallization events (the BCE stake, the Blackstone structured equity) demonstrably did not close.
